newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 16.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Monday:
- The Boeing Co said it planned to acquire the McDonnell Douglas Corp in a $13.3 billion deal.
- More than one million tourists are expected this month in New York City, in what economists and city officials predict may be one of the busiest Decembers since 1979.
- After a daylong war of words, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian leader Yasir Arafat joined in seeking to defuse rising Mideast tensions.
- Iraq promises its people more government rations now that a limited amount of Iraqi oil is starting to flow to foreign buyers for the first time since the Gulf War.
- States once reluctant to change their welfare systems are devising ambitious ways to push aid recipients into jobs.
- Liberals in the New York State Assembly are finding themselves pushed to the margins despite gains Democrats made in this year's elections.
